context: Ravengard has been killed and Florrick is either dead or imprisoned; Wyll is not with the party in this version. Cordula Eltan, an upper‑city noble, confronts the party angrily—having been told by Lady Mizora that the player and the Blade of Frontiers were involved in treachery against the duke’s family. She explains that Ravengard had warned of the Absolute and the cult, and that only a true champion can rouse the bronze wyrm Ansur sleeping beneath Baldur’s Gate. Cordula urges the party to find the tome "The Legend of Ansur," follow its path to the wyrm to save the city, and to carry a message to Wyll.
